## 9. Methodology

1. Each reviewer received `DERMATOLOGIST_REVIEW_PACK.pdf` (25
   sanitized case reports) and `DERMATOLOGIST_SCORING_FORM.pdf`
   (per-case structured form). No code, registries, scores, or
   pathway identifiers were shared.
2. Reviewers submitted `ReviewerFeedback` envelopes via the
   anonymized intake channel. The intake step strips PII and keys
   submissions on opaque `reviewerId`.
3. The aggregator loads every eligible envelope, computes
   `ConsensusReport`, and re-emits this document.
4. Block decisions follow `CLINICAL_ACCEPTANCE_GATE_SPEC.md` §3–§5
   verbatim. The gate is binary: pass or block.
